headline: BTC $81,856 (-1.0% 24h) sits 0.2% above the $81,699 ETF cost basis with hl-cycles at mild risk-off since Oct 19, while BTC OI slid to z30 -1.77 and stablecoin supply stays at z30 -3.11 ($304.9B)
tldr: Regime is mild risk-off (33% BTC, 2 of 6 stress conditions on) under a still-rising weekly trend. Main change: price slipped 1% with OI falling, a mild deleveraging, and Brent reportedly re-topped $110 on Hormuz tanker attacks. Main disagreement: the Compass reads Neutral (47) and funding sits at the floor, but the Macro lens (30, Restrictive) and contracting stablecoin supply lean the other way. Next dated catalyst: FOMC Oct 28 (per prior calendar, not re-verified). Not financial advice.

Fed funds effective 3.88% (Oct 16). Dollar index 121.40 (Oct 16, from 122.00 on Oct 14), softer. FRED Brent $126.55 and WTI $101.91 (both Oct 14); news coverage from Oct 16-19 puts Brent near or above $110 after Hormuz tanker attacks, so the two sources disagree and the FRED print is stale. Oil above $100 keeps the inflation input live ahead of the next CPI (Nov 10 per prior calendar). Stance reads hawkish-leaning with liquidity tightening: stablecoin supply is falling and net liquidity was not available. Oil falling back below $100 or dovish FOMC language would change the read.

A VIX close above 25 or SPY below its recent low would change the read.

BTC $81,856 (-1.0% 24h), ETH $2,402 (-1.2%), SOL $104.73 (-0.9%), HYPE $78.85 (-1.3%): a broad, even pullback. HL total OI $10.95B (z30 -0.83), BTC OI $3.23B (z30 -1.77, from $3.28B), ETH OI $2.58B (z30 +0.22). Price down with OI down reads as mild deleveraging, not new shorts pressing. Funding sits near the 0.00125%/h floor on BTC and HYPE (BTC z30 +0.79, skew z30 +0.65), so crowding is low and nobody is paying up to lean either way. Fear & Greed 55 (from 59, z30 -0.32), BTC DVOL 38.3 (z30 +0.82), BTC dominance 59.54%. Stablecoin supply $304.9B is z30 -3.11 (DefiLlama $303.8B, -0.77% 7d, +0.08% 30d): the one unusual reading, so dry powder is shrinking. Crypto trades roughly with the Nasdaq's 5-day slide rather than on its own, modestly macro-driven. A daily close below $79.2K (True Market Mean) would change the read.

Oct 19 closes, individually: AAPL $342.94 (-0.15% 1d, +0.58% 5d), MSFT $533.52 (+0.84%, -1.41%), NVDA $217.09 (+1.38%, -4.08%), GOOGL $344.18 (+1.05%, -2.42%), AMZN $262.45 (+4.98%, +1.13%), META $705.44 (-0.55%, -5.05%). Dispersion is wide: AMZN and AAPL are up over five sessions while META and NVDA lead the losses. SMH $548.46 (+1.61% 1d, -7.20% 5d): semis weakness is concentrated and the one-day bounce has not repaired it. AI-cycle headlines and earnings dates were not searched this run, so the earnings calendar is a gap. A SMH close below $530 would extend the read.

The Hormuz impasse remains the oil driver. Live search (coverage dated Oct 16-19) reports Brent topping $110 again on Oct 19 after tanker attacks, Hormuz transits down roughly 70% to about 254 vessels a week (UKMTO, as cited by secondary outlets), Iran saying the strait reopens only if US forces leave the region, and Ukraine vowing strikes on Russian refineries. The FRED Brent print ($126.55, Oct 14) is staler and higher than the news figures, so the level is uncertain. Scheduled catalysts, carried from the prior calendar and not re-verified this run: FOMC decision Oct 28, NFP Nov 6, CPI Nov 10. A Hormuz reopening deal would be the main de-escalation path; further tanker attacks keep the inflation input live.

thesis.observe: BTC $81,856 (-1.0% 24h), 0.2% above the $81,699 ETF cost basis and 3.4% above the True Market Mean ($79,158). hl-cycles: mild risk-off since Oct 19, allocation 33%, 2 of 6 stress conditions on (STH-SOPR below 1, ETF 7d outflow), Compass 47 (Neutral, -0.7 over 30d), Macro lens 30 (Restrictive). HL total OI $10.95B (z30 -0.83), BTC OI z30 -1.77, BTC funding 0.00125%/h (z30 +0.79). Stablecoin supply $304.9B (z30 -3.11). Fear & Greed 55. 10Y 5.09% (Oct 16), VIX 18.44, Brent $126.55 on FRED (Oct 14) versus about $110 in Oct 19 news. QQQ -3.71% over 5 sessions.
thesis.infer: Price down with OI down and funding at the floor reads as a mild flush rather than a fresh leveraged move, so a lack of crowding cuts both ways: little to squeeze, little to unwind. Contracting stablecoin supply, a Restrictive Macro lens and a risk-off regime label disagree with the up-trending weekly structure and a Neutral Compass: the market is holding a level without new leverage against a tightening backdrop. Consensus is pricing a hold on Oct 28; we read renewed oil strength as keeping the hawkish side of that meeting live.
thesis.forecast: Base case (we lean here, low-confidence): BTC chops between the True Market Mean ($79.2K) and the ETF cost basis ($81.7K) into the Oct 28 FOMC; a daily close back above $81.7K with OI recovering would soften the risk-off read, while two closes below it keep it. Tail case (low-confidence): a daily close below $79.2K could put the STH cost basis ($74.4K, about 9% below) in play. Second tail case (low-confidence): a hold with dovish language and oil below $100 may let stablecoin supply recover and BTC extend higher. Consensus is pricing a hold; we read the risk as skewing to a hawkish surprise.
